entry_point: alertd.throttle.Throttler(settings, clock).should_send(alert) -> bool; Router(notifiers, clock=..., throttler=...)

explicit_requirements.text: alertd.throttle.Throttler(settings, clock) exists; should_send(alert) returns a bool and cuts down a flood of alerts on a channel.
Router accepts an optional throttler= argument and does not send alerts the throttler rejects.

hidden_requirements.text: Critical alerts are never throttled: not by rate limits, duplicate collapsing or quiet hours.
hidden_requirements.surfaces_if: asked whether any alerts should bypass throttling, or what to do with critical alerts

hidden_requirements.text: Limits are per channel over 30 minutes: SMS 3, email 10, Slack 30.
hidden_requirements.surfaces_if: asked what the limits should be or whether they differ by channel

hidden_requirements.text: Quiet hours 22:00-07:00: only critical alerts go out; other alerts are dropped, not queued.
hidden_requirements.surfaces_if: asked about night-time / quiet hours / do-not-disturb, or what flooding looks like for them

hidden_requirements.text: Duplicates (same source and message) within 10 minutes are collapsed: only the first goes out.
hidden_requirements.surfaces_if: asked whether repeated identical alerts should be deduplicated, or what the flood is made of

hidden_requirements.text: The rate window is sliding (any 30 minutes), not fixed clock buckets.
hidden_requirements.surfaces_if: asked how the window works, or whether a burst across a boundary is ok

traps.obvious_default: One global rate limit shared across all channels.
traps.correct: Independent budgets per channel; a busy Slack channel must not block SMS or email.

traps.obvious_default: Quiet hours computed in server time / UTC.
traps.correct: Quiet hours are 22:00-07:00 in the user's own timezone (UserSettings.timezone).

code_facts.fact: The user's timezone already exists as an IANA name on UserSettings.timezone (with a .tz ZoneInfo property), and formatting already converts times into it.
The critical severity is the constant alertd.models.CRITICAL ('critical'), and Alert.is_critical exists.
Clocks return timezone-aware UTC datetimes from now(); FakeClock exists for tests.
